Homing Shot moved to be a combo after Loop Kick, Wild Rush, or Spin Slash by using Sonic Boom. Can also be comboed after boost by using the Sonic Boom action when near an enemy. When fighting Supreme, the Grand Slam can be comboed after Spinslash by using Cyloop. This action will use up meter on top of breaking through Supreme's drone defense. Alternatively, Grand Slam can be comboed after Quick Cyloop by hitting Jump when fighting Supreme. Will also consume meter and break through Supreme's defense. Both these actions will fling Supreme in to the air immediately however this only occurs with the Unused Grand Slam option enabled.
